paragraphs: BigBear.ai sells artificial intelligence software and services to government and industry customers who need decisions made quickly in the field. It describes itself as a long-standing partner of federal and defense agencies, the intelligence community, and industry.

The work spans defense, intelligence, and homeland and border security. For travel and trade, the company offers facial recognition and biometric matching for identity authentication, verification, and access control. One product captures and transmits real-time photos into a biometric matching service supporting access control and biometric boarding and bag tags. A modeling and simulation suite provides discrete event simulation and predictive analytics tools. ConductorOS is designed to transform how highly distributed edge AI systems are built and managed, running models close to where they are used.

A generative AI platform is described as supporting more than 100,000 users across 16,000 government teams. Isolated environments can be deployed at various classification levels. The homepage headlines Dutch national approval for its Pangiam threat detection. A page footer gives an address at 7950 Jones Branch Drive in McLean, Virginia.

quote.text: Go beyond the last mile, pushing the capabilities of artificial intelligence and sensor fusion to the mission’s edge.
